![Bare Bones PBR x Fresh Animations 標誌](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47ff5a35f14aedfbef907aa2ada72a7d28ccadaf.png)
-----------

這個資源包為 [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) 加入了自發光與反射紋理！

此資源包特別設計以呈現官方 Minecraft 預告片的風格，並在資源包列表中將 [Bare Bones PBR x128](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-pbr-x128) 置於下方使用。

以下是資源包列表的順序：
- Bare Bones PBR x Fresh Animations
- [Bare Bones x Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-x-fresh-animations)
- [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
- [Bare Bones PBR x128](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-pbr-x128)
- [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones)
